fields.statement: Verified attempt 2 at 59ffe16b, the fix for the confirmed quality f2 / model f3 finding. Read the diff: daemonDemand in internal/api/daemon_projects.go now filters each ready candidate by workflowStageMode(ctx, ship.For(cs), "ship"), using the same daemonShipOf dispatch as daemonPoll1 (daemon.go:849-870), in place of the built-in ship-change declaration. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-root-ship-workflow|stage-autonomy|workflow-stage-autonomy|workflow-plan-autonomy|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|autonomy-accept-rule|bugfix-workflow-autonomous|run-start-ready-dispatch|run-autonomy-source|daemon-root.*)$': ok. These cover the acceptance (plan autonomous/owner overrides, accept = owner leaves drafts proposed, ship = auto starts while the setting is owner, signoff = owner starts without --autonomous, a ship workflow's plan ignored, stage-autonomy unchanged). Ran the new daemon-root-ship-workflow.txtar against 59ffe16b~ in a scratch worktree: it fails ('no match for ^Started a run of'), so it covers the finding. The full internal/api package did not finish here: one run hit the 600s timeout at load ~15, one tripped the known write into ~/code's root state folder, and a scratch-worktree rerun was stopped for time. CI runs it before merge.
